titleEn: Meet the humanoid robot designed to do ‘the 3 D’s’ on farms in near future
titleZh: 人形机器人将在农场承担“三D”工作：脏、枯燥、危险
summaryZh: 克罗地亚科技公司Abysalto在IFAJ世界大会上展示了一款Unitree G1人形机器人原型，计划用于农业中“脏、枯燥、危险”的3D工作。该机器人目前仅供研究机构购买，售价约5万美元，预计2-3年内进入农业等产业，5-10年成为标准配置。文章介绍了其功能定位、安全性、续航、价格及语音/手势控制研发进展。
featuredReason: 该文展示了人形机器人进入农业的具体时间表和成本结构，为智慧畜牧从业者提供了对农场自动化未来形态的前瞻性参考，尤其是“3D”工作定位和语音/手势控制方向值得关注。
contentFull: Top Stories Beef Dairy Sheep Tillage Machinery Northern Ireland Videos Podcasts Top Stories Beef Dairy Sheep Tillage Machinery Northern Ireland Videos Podcasts Meet the humanoid robot designed to do 'the 3 D's' on farms in near future ![Image 1: Breifne O'Brien By Breifne O'Brien September 19, 2026 5:00 AM](https:www.agriland.iefarming-newsauthorbreifne) Share this article ![Image 2: Maja Pavlinusic is the head of marketing at Abysalto, pictured with a Unitree humanoid G1 robot ](https:www.agriland.iefarming-newsmeet-the-humanoid-robot-designed-do-the-3-ds-on-farms-in-near-future) Maja Pavlinusic is the head of marketing at Abysalto, pictured with a Unitree humanoid G1 robot What if a ‘humanoid’ robot could take on the ‘three Ds’ of farm work - dirty, dull and dangerous - in Ireland and beyond? Agriland got a sneak peak of what the future might look like in Croatia. A product of Croatian-based tech company Abysalto, the robot prototype was walking around the corridors of the International Federation of Agricultural Journalists (IFAJ) World Congress in Osijek, Croatia, on Thursday (September 17), and was even shaking hands with some of the delegates in attendance. Head of marketing at Abysalto, Maja Pavlinusic said that the robot was made in China and is a Unitree G1 humanoid robot. She said that the robot has not been rolled out yet for commercial use but can be purchased by labs and tech research companies. She added: "You can purchase it if you have a lab or are some kind of a company that's doing research and development with robots and with artificial intelligence." What will the humanoid robot be able to do? She explained that it is envisaged that the humanoid robots will be used to do work relating to 'the three D's'. The three D's involve work that is deemed: Dull; Dangerous; Dirty. The Abysalto marketing lead said that the humanoid will be used to help in tasks that are deemed 'dull' such as "picking and placing from one place to another". Also, the humanoid will be able to assist humans in work that is dirty, such as in cases where work is unsanitary or not easy for people to manage. How soon before this will be rolled out in the industry? Agriland also asked Abysalto's head of artificial intelligence (AI), Nenad Mandic for more information on the humanoid robot and when he expects they could be seen working in industry or even on farms. He said that currently the number of these humanoid robots in the world is somewhere in the "hundreds" but all of these are being used as research. He said these are mostly in China but there are also some in the US and the EU also. While these humanoid robots are currently being used for research, he expects they will be working in industry in the "very, very near future". "I would say in two to three years we will see many more in the industry including in agriculture and in 5-10 years, this [robot] will become a standard." He went on to say: "Many people ask me why this humanoid form and why not just a robotic hand - it's more efficient and this is definitely true, a robotic hand is more efficient for one task but so many jobs are designed to be done by humans." He said that work is underway on voice command for these robots but that research is also being carried out on these robots working from gestures. "If you can imagine standing in a field, one human and one robot. You can gesture to the robot how to help you," he explained. Safety According to Pavlinusic, people should have no reason to be afraid of the humanoid robots. She said: "When we say they are autonomous, we say that we train them and we give them instructions what to do but when we want them to stop. "If we want them to have some limitations within space or what they are doing, we set that as operators, as people that are engineering them and they won't do that so we shouldn't be afraid of them." Models She explained that, currently, the robot batteries last for approximately two hours if they are active but that this is expected to improve in time. While the robot on display at the event was a Unitree G1 humanoid robot, there are other models also. She said: "You have a taller one, a more heavy one, and a completely different model. "This one is G1 and it's very easy to manage because its not very tall, not very heavy." She said that the robot weighs approximately 40kg, with this model having a lift capacity of up to 15kg. Mandic emphasised: "Humanoid robots are designed to help humans and to act in human space. This is something we always need to remember." What price are they? Mandic said that these humanoid robots are not yet a "commodity" like a car or a tractor or a combine and currently are only being purchased for research. He said that demo models can be bought at approximately $50,000 but added that, as a general rule of thumb, the hardware costs tens of thousands of dollars, with the software involving considerable investment also. He concluded by saying that he expects that the "price will go down as the market grows". translationZh:
如果一款“人形”机器人能在爱尔兰乃至全球承担农场工作中的“三D”——脏、枯燥和危险——那会怎样？Agriland在克罗地亚先睹为快，看到了未来可能的样子。

这款机器人原型由克罗地亚科技公司Abysalto开发，周四（9月17日）在克罗地亚奥西耶克举行的国际农业记者联合会（IFAJ）世界大会走廊里走动，甚至与一些与会代表握手。

Abysalto市场负责人Maja Pavlinusic表示，这款机器人是中国制造的Unitree G1人形机器人。她说，该机器人尚未投入商业使用，但实验室和科技研究公司可以购买。她补充说：“如果你有实验室，或者是某种从事机器人和人工智能研发的公司，你就可以购买它。”

**这款人形机器人能做什么？**

她解释说，预计人形机器人将被用于与“三D”相关的工作。三D涉及被认为以下性质的工作：枯燥；危险；肮脏。

Abysalto市场负责人表示，这款人形机器人将用于协助被认为“枯燥”的任务，例如“从一个地方拾取并放置到另一个地方”。此外，该人形机器人还能在肮脏的工作中协助人类，例如工作不卫生或人们不易处理的情况。

**这项技术多久能在行业中推广？**

Agriland还向Abysalto人工智能（AI）负责人Nenad Mandic询问了更多关于这款人形机器人的信息，以及他预计何时能在行业甚至农场中看到它们工作。

他说，目前全球这类人形机器人的数量大约在“数百台”，但全部用于研究。他说，这些主要在中国，但美国和欧盟也有一些。

虽然这些人形机器人目前用于研究，但他预计它们将在“非常非常近的未来”进入产业工作。“我想说，两到三年内我们会看到更多机器人进入产业，包括农业；五到十年内，这（机器人）将成为标准配置。”

他接着说：“很多人问我为什么用人形，为什么不只用一只机械手——机械手更高效，这绝对是真的，机械手对单一任务更高效，但很多工作是为人类设计的。”

他说，这些机器人的语音命令研发正在进行中，但也在研究这些机器人通过手势工作。“如果你能想象站在田里，一个人和一个机器人。你可以用手势告诉机器人如何帮助你，”他解释道。

**安全性**

据Pavlinusic说，人们没有理由害怕人形机器人。她说：“当我们说它们是自主的，我们是指我们训练它们，给它们指令做什么，但当我们想让它们停下时。如果我们想限制它们在空间内或所做事情的范围，我们作为操作者、作为设计它们的工程师来设定，它们不会做那些事，所以我们不应该害怕它们。”

**型号**

她解释说，目前如果机器人活跃使用，电池大约持续两个小时，但预计这会随着时间改善。虽然活动上展示的机器人是Unitree G1人形机器人，但也有其他型号。她说：“有更高的、更重的，以及完全不同的型号。这台是G1，非常容易管理，因为它不太高，也不太重。”

她说，该机器人重约40公斤，该型号举升能力可达15公斤。Mandic强调：“人形机器人旨在帮助人类，并在人类空间中行动。这是我们始终需要记住的。”

**价格是多少？**

Mandic说，这些人形机器人还不是像汽车、拖拉机或联合收割机那样的“商品”，目前仅用于研究购买。他说，演示型号大约可以5万美元购买，但补充说，作为一般经验法则，硬件成本数万美元，软件也需要可观投资。他最后说，他预计“随着市场增长，价格会下降”。
